title: Java Database Connectivity with MySQL - GeeksforGeeks
content:
In Java, we can connect our applications to a MySQL database using JDBC (Java Database Connectivity). JDBC is a standard API that allows Java programs to execute SQL queries, retrieve data, and manipulate databases seamlessly.

Prerequisites

Before setting up JDBC with MySQL, ensure the following:

  • MySQL is installed on your system.
  • Java JDK installed on your system.

Downloading MySQL Connector

Follow these steps to download MySQL Connector/J:

  1. Search for MySQL Community Downloads.
  2. Go to Connector/J.
  3. Select Platform Independent.
  4. Download the ZIP Archive.
  5. Extract the ZIP file.
  6. Locate the JAR file:

mysql-connector-java-8.0.20.jar

Setting Up Database Connectivity with JDBC

Users have to follow the following steps:

Step 1: Create a Database

Log in to MySQL and create a database (e.g., mydb):

Java 
CREATE DATABASE mydb;

Step 2: Create a Table

Create a table in the database, for example:

Java 
CREATE TABLE designation (
    code INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    title CHAR(35) NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

Step 3: Set Up Project Directory

Create a main project folder, name it gfg. Inside gfg, create two directories:

  • src -> To store Java source files
  • lib -> To store the MySQL connector JAR

Put the MySQL connector java jar file in the lib folder.

Step 4: JDBC Connectivity Basics

To connect Java to MySQL, you need:

1. Driver Class:

com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver

2. Connection URL:

jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/mydb

  • Replace mydb with your database name.
  • Username & Password: Credentials for your MySQL database.
  • Register Driver and Establish Connection:
Java 
Class.forName("com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver");
Connection connection = DriverManager.getConnection(
    "jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/mydb", "mydbuser", "mydbuser"
);

Step 5: JDBC Code Example

In this src code, we will set up the connection and get all the data from the table. we have created the 'check.java' file in the src folder.

Example: Java program to set up connection and get all data from table

Java 
import java.sql.*;
public class Check {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Connection connection = null;
        try {
            // Load MySQL JDBC driver
            Class.forName("com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver");
            // Establish connection
            connection = DriverManager.getConnection(
                "jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/mydb", "mydbuser", "mydbuser"
            );
            // Create statement
            Statement statement = connection.createStatement();
            // Execute query
            ResultSet resultSet = statement.executeQuery("SELECT * FROM designation");
            // Process results
            while (resultSet.next()) {
                int code = resultSet.getInt("code");
                String title = resultSet.getString("title").trim();
                System.out.println("Code: " + code + " | Title: " + title);
            }
            // Close resources
            resultSet.close();
            statement.close();
            connection.close();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            System.out.println(e);
        }
    }
}

 Step 6: Compile and Run

Compile:

javac -classpath ..\lib\mysql-connector-java-8.0.20.jar;. Check.java

Run:

java -classpath ..\lib\mysql-connector-java-8.0.20.jar;. Check

Note: Make sure to manually add some sample data in the designation table before running the program.
